items.title: 油價又破百美元！30年期美債殖利率衝回24年高點
items.title_en: Oil Prices Break $100 Again! 30‑Year U.S. Treasury Yield Surges to 24‑Year High
paras: 美債賣壓再起，30年期美債殖利率回升至2002年以來最高水準，報5.72%。伊朗再度攻擊荷姆茲海峽船隻，推升布蘭特原油突破每桶102美元，加深市場對通膨加速及央行進一步升息的疑慮，也壓過部分投資人認為債市跌勢過頭、殖利率已具吸引力的看法。
據《彭博》周三(7日)報導，美債跌勢蔓延至歐洲，帶動英國30年期公債殖利率重返6%，法國同天期公債殖利率則一度攀升14個基點。政府財政赤字持續膨脹，加上中東戰事推升能源價格，已將多國公債殖利率推至數十年高點。
瑞穗國際多元資產策略師Evelyne Gomez-Liechti表示，市場仍陷於兩股力量拉鋸：一方面，目前殖利率水準具有吸引力；另一方面，油價帶來的壓力卻遲遲未退。
利率交換市場目前反映，聯準會(Fed)本月升息機率為24%，並已完全反映年底前升息一次的預期。交易員也擴大放空美債的部位，顯示這波拋售潮可能尚未結束。
近期殖利率上行，很大一部分來自期限溢酬攀升，也就是投資人持有長期債券所要求的額外報酬。這項指標自Fed9月會議後持續走高；彭博經濟研究數據顯示，截至周二，30年期美債期限溢酬已升至2011年以來最高。
美國銀行(BAC-US)利率策略師Ralf Preusser則表示，今年以來的債券熊市，主要反映市場重新評估央行政策走向。
paras_en: U.S. Treasury selling pressure has revived, pushing the 30‑year Treasury yield up to its highest level since 2002 at 5.72%. Iran’s renewed attacks on vessels in the Hormuz Strait have lifted Brent crude past $102 a barrel, deepening market concerns about accelerating inflation and further central‑bank rate hikes, and outweighing some investors’ view that the bond market’s decline is overdone and yields are already attractive.

According to Bloomberg on Wednesday the 7th, the U.S. bond sell‑off spread to Europe, sending the UK 30‑year gilt yield back above 6% and the French 30‑year gilt yield up by 14 basis points at one point. Expanding fiscal deficits and Middle‑East conflict‑driven energy price spikes have pushed many sovereign yields to multi‑decade highs.

Mizuho International multi‑asset strategist Evelyne Gomez‑Liechti said the market remains caught between two forces: on the one hand, current yield levels are attractive; on the other, the pressure from oil prices has yet to recede.

The interest‑rate swap market now reflects a 24% probability that the Fed will raise rates this month and fully prices in an expectation of one more hike by year‑end. Traders are also expanding short positions on U.S. Treasuries, indicating the sell‑off may not be over yet.

The recent upside in yields is largely driven by a rising term premium – the extra return investors demand for holding long‑dated bonds. This metric has been climbing since the Fed’s September meeting; Bloomberg Economic Research data show that as of Tuesday the 30‑year term premium has risen to its highest level since 2011.
Bank of America (BAC‑US) rate strategist Ralf Preusser said the bond bear market this year mainly reflects the market’s reassessment of central‑bank policy direction.

items.title: 10年期美債殖利率創24年新高 市場聚焦390億美元標售
items.title_en: 10-Year US Treasury Yield Hits 24-Year High, Market Focuses on $39 Billion Auction
paras: 美債殖利率周三(7日)攀升，指標10年期美債殖利率升至2002年以來最高水準。市場聚焦美國財政部即將標售的390億美元10年期公債，觀察在通膨、債務與長期持債風險疑慮下，目前殖利率是否足以吸引買盤。
10年期美債殖利率上升近8個基點至5.35%，30年期上升8.3個基點至5.724%，2年期則上升2.7個基點至4.818%。債券價格與殖利率呈反向變動。
此次10年期公債標售結果將於美東時間下午1時公布，是本周三場標售中的第二場。財政部周二已售出580億美元3年期公債，周四還將標售220億美元30年期公債。
蒙特婁銀行(BMO-US)美國利率策略主管Ian Lyngen表示，周二3年期公債標售需求令人鼓舞，得標殖利率略低於標售前市場交易水準，扭轉近期附息公債標售結果偏弱的情況。
不過，BMO認為，10年期公債標售對美債利率走勢更具指標性，預期標售前仍需透過價格下跌、殖利率上升，或相對其他天期債券變得更便宜，吸引投資人承接。
財政部周四也將回購剩餘期限20至30年的公債，以支援市場流動性，規模至少40億美元，為正常規模兩倍；上次同期限區間的回購金額略逾40億美元。
通膨與能源漲價疑慮持續壓抑債市。自7月底以來，10年期美債殖利率已攀升60個基點，同期美國原油價格大漲20%。歐洲債市也承壓，法國10年期公債殖利率上升12個基點至4.876%，英國同天期殖利率上升7個基點至5.447%。
市場另關注美東時間下午2時公布的聯準會(Fed)9月會議紀錄，尋找2023年以來首次升息後的政策線索。紐約聯準銀行上午11時公布的消費者預期調查，也將提供未來1年、3年與5年的通膨預期。
paras_en: US Treasury yields rose on Wednesday (the 7th), with the benchmark 10-year yield climbing to its highest level since 2002. The market is focusing on the Treasury’s upcoming $39 billion auction of 10-year notes, watching whether yields are high enough to attract buyers amid inflation, debt and long‑term holding‑risk concerns.
The 10-year yield rose about 8 basis points to 5.35%, the 30-year rose 8.3 basis points to 5.724%, and the 2-year rose 2.7 basis points to 4.818%. Bond prices move inversely to yields.

The result of the 10-year auction will be announced at 1 p.m. Eastern Time; it is the second auction of the week. The Treasury sold $58 billion of 3‑year notes on Tuesday and will auction $22 billion of 30‑year notes on Thursday.

Ian Lyngen, head of US rate strategy at BMO‑US, said demand for Tuesday’s 3‑year auction was encouraging, with the awarded yield slightly below the pre‑auction market level, reversing the recent weakness seen in coupon‑bearing note auctions.

However, BMO believes the 10‑year auction is more indicative of the direction of US Treasury rates and expects that, before the auction, prices will need to fall and yields rise—or the notes will need to become relatively cheaper than other maturities—to attract investors.

The Treasury will also repurchase remaining 20‑ to 30‑year bonds on Thursday to support market liquidity, with a size of at least $4 billion—twice the normal amount; the last repurchase in that maturity range was just over $4 billion.

Inflation and energy‑price concerns continue to weigh on the bond market. Since the end of July, the 10‑year yield has risen 60 basis points, while US crude oil prices have jumped about 20%. European bonds are also under pressure, with France’s 10‑year yield up 12 basis points to 4.876% and the UK’s 10‑year yield up 7 basis points to 5.447%.

The market is also watching for the Fed’s September meeting minutes, to be released at 2 p.m. Eastern Time, for clues after the first rate hike since 2023, and the New York Fed’s consumer expectations survey released at 11 a.m., which will provide inflation expectations for the next 1, 3 and 5 years.

items.title: 荷姆茲海峽衝突升溫推升通膨疑慮 金價跌破4120美元
items.title_en: Houthi Strait Conflict Escalates Raising Inflation Concerns, Gold Falls Below $4,120
paras: 伊朗加劇對荷姆茲海峽油輪的襲擊，導致石油與天然氣價格飆升，再次引發市場對戰爭引發通膨的擔憂，黃金價格應聲下跌超過1%，抹去前一交易日的漲幅並跌破每盎司4,120美元關卡。
倫敦時間上午10時43分，現貨黃金下跌1.2%至每盎司4,113.83美元，白銀下挫2%至60.08美元，鉑金與鈀金同步走低；彭博美元現貨指數則上漲0.3%。
隨著美伊衝突進入第八個月，德黑蘭近日加快襲擊頻率，石油高層警告全球管理戰事衝擊的緩衝手段正逐漸耗盡。儘管中東石油運輸量已回升至接近衝突前水準，但高風險使航運成本持續處於近乎前所未有的高位。
能源成本攀升引發通膨，促使主要央行實施貨幣緊縮政策，對無收益的黃金形成利空壓制。自2月下旬衝突爆發以來，金價累計跌幅已超過五分之一。
另一方面，美國國債殖利率攀升至近2002年以來高點，市場正面臨390億美元10年期國債拍賣的考驗。交易員同時剖析聯準會9月會議紀錄以尋求利率軌跡線索。隨著官員淡化即將緊縮的可能性，交易員預估10月升息機率已自上周初的70%大幅降至約22%。
華僑銀行(OCBC)策略師Christopher Wong指出，黃金仍缺乏持續反轉的明確催化劑。然而，本周於義大利聚會的各國央行官員強調，地緣政治風險正凸顯黃金作為避險與多元化外匯存底的戰略角色。
paras_en: Iran intensified attacks on oil tankers in the Houthi Strait, sending oil and gas prices soaring and reviving market worries that war could spark inflation. Gold prices responded by dropping more than 1%, erasing the previous day's gains and slipping below the $4,120 per ounce threshold.
At 10:43 a.m. London time, spot gold fell 1.2% to $4,113.83 per ounce, while silver slid 2% to $60.08, and both platinum and palladium moved lower; the Bloomberg dollar spot index rose 0.3%.

As the US‑Iran conflict entered its eighth month, Tehran has recently accelerated the frequency of its attacks, and senior oil officials warned that global buffers for war‑related shocks are gradually running out. Although Middle‑East oil shipments have rebounded to near pre‑conflict levels, the heightened risk keeps shipping costs at almost unprecedented heights.

Rising energy costs are fuelling inflation, prompting major central banks to tighten monetary policy, which weighs on non‑yielding gold. Since the conflict erupted in late February, gold has lost more than one‑fifth of its value cumulatively.

Meanwhile, US Treasury yields have climbed to their highest levels since 2002, and the market faces a $39 billion 10‑year Treasury auction. Traders are also dissecting the Fed’s September meeting minutes for clues on the rate path. With officials downplaying the likelihood of further tightening, traders now see the odds of an October rate hike falling sharply from about 70% at the start of last week to roughly 22%.

OCBC strategist Christopher Wong said gold still lacks a clear catalyst for a sustained reversal. However, central bank officials gathered in Italy this week emphasized that geopolitical risk is highlighting gold’s strategic role as a hedge and a diversifier for foreign‑exchange reserves.

items.title: 微軟、輝達CEO將親自站台 共推新款AI筆電 宣告「本地AI代理」時代來臨
items.title_en: Microsoft and Nvidia CEOs to Appear in Person to Launch New AI Laptop, Announcing the Era of "Local AI Agents"
paras: 分析師指出，微軟(MSFT-US)將於周三(7日)發表一款搭載輝達(NVDA-US)晶片的新筆記型電腦。此舉旨在將 Windows 打造為一個平台，讓 AI 代理(AI agents)能夠在無需存取雲端的情況下，處理編寫程式碼等任務。
微軟將在舊金山舉辦此次發表會，官方稱之為關於 Windows 作業系統及 Surface 硬體系列的更新發布。發表會上，預計由微軟執行長 Satya Nadella 與輝達執行長黃仁勳親自揭曉這款旗艦級筆電 Surface Laptop Ultra。
這款裝置搭載輝達與聯發科合作開發的 Arm 架構 RTX Spark 系統單晶片，並讓 AI 代理不必連線至雲端資料中心，即可直接在本地端執行撰寫程式碼或處理複雜商業專案等任務。
此策略有助於減輕微軟 Azure 資料中心的運算壓力，並在傳統由英特爾(INTC-US)與超微(AMD-US)主導的 Windows 個人電腦市場中，搶占邊緣運算先機，直接對標蘋果(AAPL-US)的 Mac 系列產品。
硬體配置方面，Surface Laptop Ultra 推出兩種版本，入門款搭載 18 核心 CPU 與 24GB 統一記憶體，高階款則配備 20 核心 CPU，記憶體最高可擴充至 128GB。螢幕採用 15 吋 mini-LED 觸控螢幕，輝達宣稱 RTX Spark 具備 1 Petaflop 的 FP4 AI 運算效能，且無論是否連接電源都能維持幾乎相同的效能輸出。
然而，價格成為該款筆電推廣的最大挑戰。受全球記憶體晶片短缺影響，高容量記憶體成本大幅攀升。市場預估 Surface Laptop Ultra 起售價將超過 2,000 美元，頂規 128GB 版本價格甚至可能高達 7,000 至 8,000 美元。
Moor Insights & Strategy 分析師 Anshel Sag表示，兩年前，軟體還沒準備好，但硬體準備好了。現在軟體準備好了，但硬體太貴，無法在本地運行，恐使本地端 AI 運算設備暫時成為僅有高預算買家才能負擔的奢華產品。
paras_en: Analysts note that Microsoft (MSFT-US) will unveil on Wednesday (the 7th) a new laptop powered by an Nvidia (NVDA-US) chip. The move aims to make Windows a platform where AI agents can perform tasks such as code writing without needing to access the cloud.

Microsoft will hold the launch in San Francisco, officially described as an update release for the Windows operating system and the Surface hardware lineup. The event is expected to feature Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella and Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang personally unveiling the flagship Surface Laptop Ultra.

The device is equipped with an Arm‑based RTX Spark system‑on‑chip co‑developed by Nvidia and MediaTek, allowing AI agents to run locally—writing code or handling complex business projects—without connecting to a cloud data center.

The strategy helps relieve computing pressure on Microsoft Azure data centers and aims to capture edge‑computing opportunities in the Windows PC market traditionally dominated by Intel (INTC-US) and AMD (AMD-US), directly challenging Apple’s (AAPL-US) Mac lineup.

In terms of hardware, the Surface Laptop Ultra will be offered in two configurations: a base model with an 18‑core CPU and 24 GB of unified memory, and a premium model with a 20‑core CPU and memory expandable up to 128 GB. It sports a 15‑inch mini‑LED touch display, and Nvidia claims the RTX Spark delivers 1 petaflop of FP4 AI performance, maintaining nearly identical output whether or not the laptop is plugged in.

However, price is the biggest hurdle for the laptop’s adoption. Global memory‑chip shortages have driven up the cost of high‑capacity RAM sharply. Market estimates put the starting price of the Surface Laptop Ultra above $2,000, with the top‑spec 128 GB version potentially costing $7,000 to $8,000.

Moor Insights & Strategy analyst Anshel Sag said that two years ago the software wasn’t ready but the hardware was; now the software is ready but the hardware is too expensive to run locally, risking that on‑premise AI compute devices will remain a luxury only affordable to high‑budget buyers.

items.title: 奇鋐、富世達新莊廠區遭調查局搜索 與富世達2023年申請上市有關
items.title_en: Qihong and Fushida Xinzhang Plant Searched by Investigation Bureau, Linked to Fushida's 2023 IPO Application
paras: 軸承廠富世達(6805-TW)及母公司散熱大廠奇鋐(3017-TW)今(7)日同步發出重訊指出，法務部調查局赴新莊廠區，針對特定員工進行搜索及調查。
兩家公司重訊公告指出，本次搜索及詢問主要是與富世達於2023年申請上市期間的相關事宜，依法配合相關調查程序，對公司營運並無影響。
paras_en: Bearing manufacturer Fushida (6805-TW) and its parent, heat‑sink giant Qihong (3017‑TW) issued a joint statement today (the 7th) that the Ministry of Justice’s Investigation Bureau conducted searches and investigations at their Xinzhang plant targeting specific employees.

The companies said the searches and inquiries are primarily related to matters concerning Fushida’s 2023 IPO filing, and that they are cooperating with the investigation in accordance with the law, with no impact on business operations.

items.title: 榮剛鑄鍛雙核心引擎到位 拓展AI、半導體及國防市場
items.title_en: Ronggang Deploys Dual Core Casting and Forging Engines, Expands into AI, Semiconductor and Defense Markets
paras: 台鋼集團旗下特殊鋼廠榮剛(5009-TW)今（7）日在舉辦新鑄鍛產品發表會，正式發表全台噸數最大的「8000噸油壓鍛造設備」、全新鑄造專線，並推出易切削不銹鋼「EVERCUT+」及「EVERCUT PLUS」雙商標，進一步完善台灣特殊鋼自主供應鏈，拓展AI、半導體及國防市場。
榮剛董事長王炯棻表示，在全球強調「生產自主化」的供應鏈去風險化趨勢下，台灣特殊鋼產業起步雖晚，但榮剛已具備完整在地化生產供應鏈。隨著「鑄造、鍛造」雙核心引擎正式建置完成，將攜手國內產業追求卓越，共同拓展全球市場。
榮剛過去以鍛造生產為主，此次建置連續鑄造設備（CCM），實現鋼胚半成品自主生產，並可供應更小尺寸及更長長度產品；同時引進垂直澆鑄機（VCM），讓鋼液垂直向下流動凝固，有別於傳統弧型連鑄機需經過彎曲及矯正的製程，可有效避免裂紋產生，適合生產高品質合金鋼、不銹鋼及超高強度特殊鋼材，連續生產也能建立成本優勢。
在鍛造端，8000噸油壓鍛造機則讓榮剛突破過去以圓棒產品為主的限制，全面跨足「大塊料Die Block」市場，進軍模具產業，並有助於解決國內大型塊料長期仰賴進口的問題。隨著新設備加入，圓棒供應尺寸由直徑600毫米擴大至1000毫米，生產時間足足縮短3倍，加上鍛造平面度佳、可減少加工去除量及脫碳層等優勢，可提升整體得料率。
隨著台灣特殊鋼產業目前接單領域已從航太、能源、油氣等產業，進一步拓展至半導體、AI、液冷及軍工等領域，此次榮剛發表會也展示長度近7公尺的戰車砲管「105公釐砲身」，採用榮剛生產的合金鍛鋼，展現落實國防產業自主能量上的實力。
此外，隨著AI浪潮發展，半導體及真空產業對不銹鋼易加工性的需求成長，榮剛研發團隊歷時1年改良30年前推出的易切削不銹鋼品牌EVERCUT，推出「EVERCUT+」與「EVERCUT PLUS」，透過熔煉技術精準加入硫、鈣處理，使材料在車削時更容易斷屑，提升加工效率，迎合客戶需求。
paras_en: Ronggang (5009-TW), the special steel subsidiary of Taiwan Steel Group, held a new casting‑forging product launch today (the 7th), officially unveiling Taiwan’s largest 8,000‑ton hydraulic forging equipment, a brand‑new casting line, and introducing the dual trademarks EVERCUT+ and EVERCUT PLUS for easy‑cut stainless steel, further strengthening Taiwan’s domestic special‑steel supply chain and expanding into AI, semiconductor and defense markets.

Chairman Wang Jiong‑fen said that amid a global trend emphasizing “production autonomy” and supply‑chain risk mitigation, Taiwan’s special‑steel industry started late but Ronggang already possesses a complete localized production supply chain. With the dual‑core “casting and forging” engine now fully established, the company will collaborate with domestic industries to pursue excellence and jointly expand into global markets.

Historically focused on forging, Ronggang has now installed continuous casting equipment (CCM) to achieve in‑house production of semi‑finished steel billets, enabling supply of smaller dimensions and longer lengths. It also introduced a vertical casting machine (VCM) that lets molten steel flow vertically downward to solidify, unlike traditional curved continuous casting machines that require bending and straightening, thereby effectively preventing cracks. This is suitable for producing high‑quality alloy steel, stainless steel and ultra‑high‑strength special steel, and continuous production also creates cost advantages.

On the forging side, the 8,000‑ton hydraulic forging press allows Ronggang to break past its previous focus on round bar products and fully enter the “large‑block die block” market, moving into the mold industry and helping solve the domestic reliance on imported large blocks. With the new equipment, round‑bar diameters have expanded from 600 mm to 1,000 mm, production time has been cut by a factor of three, and the improved flatness reduces machining removal and decarburization layers, thereby boosting overall material yield.

As Taiwan’s special‑steel sector has already taken orders from aerospace, energy and oil‑gas sectors and is now further expanding into semiconductors, AI, liquid‑cooling and military‑industrial fields, the launch event also showcased a nearly 7‑meter‑long tank gun barrel “105 mm barrel” made from Ronggang’s alloy forging steel, demonstrating its capability to support an autonomous defense industry.

Moreover, driven by the AI wave, demand for easily machinable stainless steel from the semiconductor and vacuum industries is growing. Ronggang’s R&D team spent a year improving the EVERCUT brand, originally launched 30 years ago, to create EVERCUT+ and EVERCUT PLUS. By precisely adding sulfur and calcium during melting, the material chips more readily during turning, enhancing machining efficiency and meeting customer needs.

items.title: 東航空姐下跪事件延燒 乘客是上市公司董事長？萬年青製藥回應
items.title_en: China Eastern Flight Attendant Kneeling Incident Escalates; Passenger Allegedly Chairman of Listed Company? Wan Nianqing Pharma Responds
paras: 東航(CEA-US) (00670-HK) 空姐下跪事件延燒，廣東萬年青製藥公司7日（周三）發布關於網路不實訊息侵害公司及相關人員名譽的聲明。
萬年青製藥公司表示，近日部分網路平台流傳「9月28日東航MU6741航班客艙衝突事件涉事旅客為廣東萬年青製藥股份有限公司董事長歐先濤先生」的內容，引發關注熱議。
萬年青製藥公司說，經公司核實，該內容與事實嚴重不符，歐先濤先生及公司其他員工從未乘坐該航班，上述訊息是惡意捏造，已侵害公司董事長個人名譽及公司商業信譽。
萬年青製藥公司稱，針對上述侵權行為，歐先濤先生已向公安機關報案，並獲受理，公司也同步就相關傳播內容展開證據留存與保全工作。公司將根據法律法規對造謠者及惡意傳播者追究全部法律責任。
上月29日一則「航班乘務員下跪」的帖子在社交平台流傳。
帖子稱，一架由合肥飛往大連的航班上，一名乘務員（空服員）推餐車時碰到旅客手肘並道歉，該旅客仍表示不滿，並提出「要嘛讓我踹一腳」等要求。
隨後乘務員哭泣、下跪，安全員介入，旅客還要求乘務長（座艙長）和涉事乘務員下班後陪同其前往醫院檢查。
據《極目新聞》報導，該網友張先生稱28日晚9時許，他乘坐從合肥到大連的航班，途中拍到上述一幕，「當時空姐跪了兩三次，挺久的，我沒有錄到全程影片」。
「餐車移動速度不快，那個被撞的男子沒出血，乘務長也拿來冰袋敷著，應該不嚴重。」張先生表示，後來該男子要求下機帶他去醫院檢查。
媒體報導後不久，張先生刪除上述影片，他說「電話被打爆了」。
東航對此表示，經核實，航班乘務員在推餐車提供飲料服務過程中，全程提示旅客注意，一名旅客處於睡眠狀態，不慎造成餐車與其手肘發生觸碰。
乘務員當即反覆致歉，查看旅客狀況。該旅客情緒激動，連續使用粗俗過激言語，並出現威脅腳踢乘務員、要求當事乘務員落地後陪同就醫等言行，該乘務員受到驚嚇。
為維護飛行安全和客艙秩序，乘務長、安全員迅速介入協同處置。航班落地後，醫護人員上機檢查旅客未有明顯外傷或腫脹、無須進一步處理，旅客拒絕地面人員陪同送醫，自行離開。
東航說，事件發生後，第一時間對當事乘務員展開心理疏導與關懷支持，該員工已恢復正常工作。在此，對關心支持民航一線員工的旅客、公眾表示感謝。
paras_en: China Eastern Airlines (CEA-US) (00670-HK) flight attendant kneeling incident continues to flare up, and Guangdong Wan Nianqing Pharmaceutical Company issued a statement on Wednesday the 7th regarding false online information that harmed the reputation of the company and related personnel.

Wan Nianqing Pharmaceutical said that recent posts on some online platforms claimed that the passenger involved in the September 28 cabin conflict on China Eastern MU6741 was Mr. Ou Xiantao, chairman of Guangdong Wan Nianqing Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd., sparking heated discussion.

The company stated that after verification, the claim is seriously inconsistent with facts; Mr. Ou and other employees never boarded that flight, the information is a malicious fabrication that has damaged the chairman’s personal reputation and the company’s commercial credibility.

Wan Nianqing said that regarding the infringement, Mr. Ou has reported the matter to public security authorities, which have accepted the case, and the company is simultaneously preserving evidence of the related content. The company will pursue full legal liability against the rumor‑mongers and malicious disseminators in accordance with laws and regulations.
A post about a "flight attendant kneeling" circulated on social media on the 29th of last month.

The post claimed that on a flight from Hefei to Dalian, a crew member (flight attendant) bumped a passenger’s elbow while pushing a trolley, apologized, but the passenger remained dissatisfied and demanded, among other things, "let me kick you".
Subsequently the crew member cried and knelt, a safety officer intervened, and the passenger also demanded that the purser and the involved crew member accompany him to a hospital after the flight.

According to Jimu News, the netizen Mr. Zhang said that around 9 p.m. on the 28th he was on the Hefei‑Dalian flight and captured the scene, noting "the flight attendant knelt two or three times, for quite a while; I didn’t record the whole video."

Mr. Zhang added, "The trolley wasn’t moving fast, the man who was hit didn’t bleed, the purser applied an ice pack, so it shouldn’t be serious." He later said the man requested to deplane and be taken to a hospital for examination.
Shortly after the media report, Mr. Zhang deleted the video, saying his phone was "bombarded with calls."

China Eastern said that after verification, during the beverage service the crew member repeatedly reminded passengers to be careful; a passenger who was asleep inadvertently caused the trolley to brush his elbow.

The crew member immediately apologized repeatedly and checked the passenger’s condition. The passenger became emotionally agitated, used vulgar and aggressive language, threatened to kick the crew member and demanded that the crew accompany him to a hospital after landing, which frightened the crew member.

To maintain flight safety and cabin order, the purser and safety officer promptly intervened and coordinated a response. After landing, medical staff inspected the passenger and found no obvious injuries or swelling, requiring no further treatment; the passenger refused ground staff accompaniment to a hospital and left on his own.

China Eastern said that after the incident, it promptly provided psychological counseling and support to the involved crew member, who has now returned to normal duties, and expressed gratitude to the passengers and public for their concern and support for frontline civil‑aviation staff.

paras_en: Taiwan stocks today (the 7th) displayed a high‑level oscillating pattern, with capital shifting from heavyweight electronics stocks to financials, traditional industries and plastics groups. The market‑leading TSMC (2330‑TW) bought shares, supporting the price and keeping it flat, ending slightly down 16 points at 49,806, with a turnover of NT$9,259 billion. The three major institutional investors were all net sellers, collectively offloading NT$24.163 billion. Foreign investors were the biggest buyers, topping out with 35,600 shares of Formosa Plastics (1301‑TW); the most heavily sold ETF was the active CITIC Taiwan Yield (00406A‑TW) with 82,000 shares, followed by a large sell‑off of AU Optronics of 76,000 shares.

Post‑market data shows that among the three major institutions, foreign investors sold NT$13.044 billion today; investment trusts sold NT$3.323 billion; and proprietary traders sold NT$7.796 billion, together amounting to a total net sell of NT$24.163 billion.

Among the top‑10 net‑buy positions for foreign investors, five were traditional‑industry stocks. They are bullish on Formosa Plastics’ transformation, buying a net 35,600 shares, the highest. Next were Hua‑Xin (2.2 万 shares), Hua‑Bang Electronics (2.05 万), Tai‑Jin‑Bao‑DR (2.03 万), Taiwan Glass (1.72 万), Taiwan Chemical (1.57 万), the active Uni‑Upgrade 50 (00403A‑TW) (1.46 万), Sinopec (1.26 万), Kai Fund (1.21 万) and Nan‑Ya (1.19 万).

In the foreign investors’ top‑10 net‑sell list, four were active ETFs. The most heavily sold was the active CITIC Taiwan Yield with 82,000 shares, followed by AU Optronics (76,100), Powerchip (36,300), CITIC Taiwan‑Japan‑Korea PCB (009828‑TW) (25,600), Yuanta Taiwan 50 (0050‑TW) (24,100), the active Cathay Momentum High‑Yield (19,600), Fuhua FTSE Real Estate (00712) (15,700), United Microelectronics (15,300), the active Quanta‑Tech Innovation (00992A‑TW) (114,800) and Foxconn (11,700).

Among the top‑10 net‑buy positions for investment trusts, there were also five Formosa Plastics‑group or traditional‑industry stocks. The biggest net buy was Formosa Plastics with 10,200 shares, followed by Taiwan Cement (4,731), Formosa Chemicals (3,787), Yageo (3,037), Hua‑Xin (2,593), China Airlines (2,536), Sino‑Financial (1,896), Wen‑Yeh (1,293), Nan‑Ya (1,213) and Uni‑Group (1,186).

In the investment trusts’ top‑10 net‑sell list, United Microelectronics led with a net sell of 17,600 shares, followed by Hua‑Bang Electronics (7,282), Mega Financial (6,177), Full‑New (2,424), the active Nomura Taiwan Select (2,372), Wistron (1,754), Xingfu Development (1,518), Chang‑Hsing (1,500), Nan‑Ya Technology (1,496) and Dacheng Steel (1,402).

Institutional commentary noted that today’s market showed a high‑level oscillating pattern, with capital flowing into financials, traditional industries, cement, plastics and textiles, indicating healthy sector rotation. The late‑session buying by market‑leading TSMC helped lift the price and keep it near the flat level.

From a technical perspective, institutions said the index’s short‑, medium‑ and long‑term moving averages remain in a bullish arrangement, suggesting continued upward‑biased oscillation. However, if the market pushes higher, sell‑pressure may re‑emerge, especially ahead of the upcoming Double‑Ten holiday. Historically, pre‑holiday periods see heightened caution and reduced trading volume.

items.title: 奇鋐、富世達新莊廠區遭調查局搜索 與富世達2023年申請上市有關
items.title_en: Qihong and Fushida Xinzhang Plant Searched by Investigation Bureau, Linked to Fushida's 2023 IPO Application
paras: 軸承廠富世達(6805-TW)及母公司散熱大廠奇鋐(3017-TW)今(7)日同步發出重訊指出，法務部調查局赴新莊廠區，針對特定員工進行搜索及調查。
兩家公司重訊公告指出，本次搜索及詢問主要是與富世達於2023年申請上市期間的相關事宜，依法配合相關調查程序，對公司營運並無影響。
paras_en: Bearing manufacturer Fushida (6805-TW) and its parent, heat‑sink giant Qihong (3017‑TW) issued a joint statement today (the 7th) that the Ministry of Justice’s Investigation Bureau conducted searches and investigations at their Xinzhang plant targeting specific employees.

The companies said the searches and inquiries are primarily related to matters concerning Fushida’s 2023 IPO filing, and that they are cooperating with the investigation in accordance with the law, with no impact on business operations.

items.title: 中興電印度布局再受關注：昔日GIS合作夥伴上市，當地重電訂單能見度拉長
items.title_en: ZTE's India Strategy Gains Renewed Attention: Former GIS Partner Goes Public, Extending Visibility of Heavy‑Electrical Orders
paras: 2026年10月07日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 印度高壓輸配電投資持續擴大，當地重電設備暨電力工程EPC廠商Kanohar Electricals最新訂單能見度已拉長至18至24個月。公司於2026年9月16日在印度NSE與BSE掛牌，截至2026年6月底未完成訂單達202.6億印度盧比（約2.09億美元），至9月底又新增86.73億印度盧比（約8,960萬美元）訂單，其中包括一筆超過25億印度盧比（約2,580萬美元）的中央公營事業大型訂單，反映當地電網、變電與高壓設備投資維持熱度。
印度近年也持續擴大輸電與變電建設，當地變壓器廠商Supreme Power Equipment預估，印度輸配電基礎建設至2032年的資本支出預估達9.15兆印度盧比（約945億美元），與GIS需求直接相關的電網資本支出規模約2兆印度盧比（約207億美元）。
不過另一方面，印度也積極建立本地GIS供應鏈；中興電早在2011年就曾與印度Kanohar建立GIS製造合作關係，而該公司也因此切入GIS的工程統包業務，由於全球 GIS 製造商產能已接近滿載，主要 GIS 製造商（ABB、Siemens、Hitachi Energy、Schneider 等）的排程已高度飽和，中興電在印度重電市場後續的訂單與合作進展，仍值得持續追蹤。
除了印度以外，歐盟已自2026年1月起禁止中壓開關設備使用SF₆，要求公用事業、工業場所和商業建築以真空或乾式空氣替代方案取代現有SF₆設備。歐洲、北美及亞洲部分地區的立法框架正要求逐步淘汰並最終完全禁止新的SF₆設備安裝，代表GIS不僅新增需求，還有龐大的存量替換需求。
全球高壓GIS正朝環保氣體與無SF₆技術加速轉型，歐盟SF₆禁令已於2026年1月生效，替換需求正在集中釋放，但大廠如Hitachi Energy南卡工廠等主要新產能要到2027年才能投產。現有產能利用率已接近上限。預計GIS交貨期將維持在較長水平，價格議價空間有限。而中國西電電氣(的變壓器與高壓開關設備產能利用率也已接近100%，顯示中國高壓重電設備供應同樣處於高稼動狀態。
中興電目前GIS主要出口市場仍以日本為主，由中國廠區供應GIS與GCB相關產品；美國則鎖定半導體海外建廠需求，印度仍處於接洽與觀察階段。若日本既有出貨持續放量，加上美國與印度市場逐步取得新訂單，中興電GIS海外營收結構才有機會進一步擴大。
不過，GIS等重電設備進入海外市場通常須經過較長時間的產品驗證，且各國電力設備市場普遍具有一定程度的在地供應要求，因此，認證時程與本土化供應能力，仍將是中興電擴大海外接單面臨的主要門檻。

paras_en: On October 7, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – India’s high‑voltage transmission and distribution investment continues to expand, and the order visibility for local heavy‑electrical equipment and power‑engineering EPC firm Kanohar Electricals has been extended to 18‑24 months. The company listed on India’s NSE and BSE on September 16, 2026, and by the end of June 2026 had pending orders worth INR 20.26 billion (about US$209 million). By the end of September it added another INR 8.673 billion (about US$89.6 million), including a central public‑utility large order exceeding INR 2.5 billion (about US$25.8 million), reflecting sustained heat in grid, substation and high‑voltage equipment investment.

India has also been steadily expanding its transmission and substation construction. Domestic transformer maker Supreme Power Equipment estimates capital expenditure on transmission and distribution infrastructure through 2032 will reach INR 9.15 trillion (about US$94.5 billion), with grid‑related spending tied to GIS demand accounting for roughly INR 2 trillion (about US$20.7 billion).

On the other hand, India is actively building a local GIS supply chain; ZTE first partnered with Kanohar in 2011 to manufacture GIS, giving the Indian firm entry into turnkey GIS projects. Because global GIS manufacturers are nearing full capacity and major players such as ABB, Siemens, Hitachi Energy and Schneider are heavily booked, ZTE’s future order flow and cooperation in India’s heavy‑electrical market remain worth watching.

Beyond India, the EU has banned the use of SF₆ in medium‑voltage switchgear since January 2026, requiring utilities, industrial sites and commercial buildings to replace existing SF₆ equipment with vacuum or dry‑air solutions. Legislative frameworks in Europe, North America and parts of Asia are moving toward phased phase‑out and eventual outright bans on new SF₆ installations, meaning GIS not only faces new demand but also a large stock‑replacement market.

The global high‑voltage GIS market is rapidly shifting toward eco‑friendly gases and SF₆‑free technologies. The EU SF₆ ban took effect in January 2026, releasing replacement demand, yet major new capacity such as Hitachi Energy’s South Carolina plant won’t be online until 2027. Existing capacity utilization is already near its limit, keeping GIS lead times long and price negotiation space tight. China’s Xidian Electric’s transformer and high‑voltage switchgear capacity is also close to 100%, indicating Chinese heavy‑electrical supply is similarly operating at high utilization.

ZTE’s GIS exports remain dominated by Japan, with GIS and GCB products supplied from its Chinese factories; the United States is targeting semiconductor overseas‑plant demand, while India is still in the discussion and observation stage. If Japan’s shipments continue to grow and ZTE secures new orders in the U.S. and India, the overseas GIS revenue mix could expand further.

However, entering overseas markets with GIS and other heavy‑electrical equipment typically requires lengthy product certification, and most countries’ power‑equipment markets impose local‑supply requirements. Thus, certification timelines and local‑supply capabilities will remain the main hurdles for ZTE to increase overseas order intake.

items.title: 榮剛鑄鍛雙核心引擎到位 拓展AI、半導體及國防市場
items.title_en: Ronggang Deploys Dual Core Casting and Forging Engines, Expands into AI, Semiconductor and Defense Markets
paras: 台鋼集團旗下特殊鋼廠榮剛(5009-TW)今（7）日在舉辦新鑄鍛產品發表會，正式發表全台噸數最大的「8000噸油壓鍛造設備」、全新鑄造專線，並推出易切削不銹鋼「EVERCUT+」及「EVERCUT PLUS」雙商標，進一步完善台灣特殊鋼自主供應鏈，拓展AI、半導體及國防市場。
榮剛董事長王炯棻表示，在全球強調「生產自主化」的供應鏈去風險化趨勢下，台灣特殊鋼產業起步雖晚，但榮剛已具備完整在地化生產供應鏈。隨著「鑄造、鍛造」雙核心引擎正式建置完成，將攜手國內產業追求卓越，共同拓展全球市場。
榮剛過去以鍛造生產為主，此次建置連續鑄造設備（CCM），實現鋼胚半成品自主生產，並可供應更小尺寸及更長長度產品；同時引進垂直澆鑄機（VCM），讓鋼液垂直向下流動凝固，有別於傳統弧型連鑄機需經過彎曲及矯正的製程，可有效避免裂紋產生，適合生產高品質合金鋼、不銹鋼及超高強度特殊鋼材，連續生產也能建立成本優勢。
在鍛造端，8000噸油壓鍛造機則讓榮剛突破過去以圓棒產品為主的限制，全面跨足「大塊料Die Block」市場，進軍模具產業，並有助於解決國內大型塊料長期仰賴進口的問題。隨著新設備加入，圓棒供應尺寸由直徑600毫米擴大至1000毫米，生產時間足足縮短3倍，加上鍛造平面度佳、可減少加工去除量及脫碳層等優勢，可提升整體得料率。
隨著台灣特殊鋼產業目前接單領域已從航太、能源、油氣等產業，進一步拓展至半導體、AI、液冷及軍工等領域，此次榮剛發表會也展示長度近7公尺的戰車砲管「105公釐砲身」，採用榮剛生產的合金鍛鋼，展現落實國防產業自主能量上的實力。
此外，隨著AI浪潮發展，半導體及真空產業對不銹鋼易加工性的需求成長，榮剛研發團隊歷時1年改良30年前推出的易切削不銹鋼品牌EVERCUT，推出「EVERCUT+」與「EVERCUT PLUS」，透過熔煉技術精準加入硫、鈣處理，使材料在車削時更容易斷屑，提升加工效率，迎合客戶需求。
paras_en: Ronggang (5009-TW), the special steel subsidiary of Taiwan Steel Group, held a new casting‑forging product launch today (the 7th), officially unveiling Taiwan’s largest 8,000‑ton hydraulic forging equipment, a brand‑new casting line, and introducing the dual trademarks EVERCUT+ and EVERCUT PLUS for easy‑cut stainless steel, further strengthening Taiwan’s domestic special‑steel supply chain and expanding into AI, semiconductor and defense markets.

Chairman Wang Jiong‑fen said that amid a global trend emphasizing “production autonomy” and supply‑chain risk mitigation, Taiwan’s special‑steel industry started late but Ronggang already possesses a complete localized production supply chain. With the dual‑core “casting and forging” engine now fully established, the company will collaborate with domestic industries to pursue excellence and jointly expand into global markets.

Historically focused on forging, Ronggang has now installed continuous casting equipment (CCM) to achieve in‑house production of semi‑finished steel billets, enabling supply of smaller dimensions and longer lengths. It also introduced a vertical casting machine (VCM) that lets molten steel flow vertically downward to solidify, unlike traditional curved continuous casting machines that require bending and straightening, thereby effectively preventing cracks. This is suitable for producing high‑quality alloy steel, stainless steel and ultra‑high‑strength special steel, and continuous production also creates cost advantages.

On the forging side, the 8,000‑ton hydraulic forging press allows Ronggang to break past its previous focus on round bar products and fully enter the “large‑block die block” market, moving into the mold industry and helping solve the domestic reliance on imported large blocks. With the new equipment, round‑bar diameters have expanded from 600 mm to 1,000 mm, production time has been cut by a factor of three, and the improved flatness reduces machining removal and decarburization layers, thereby boosting overall material yield.

As Taiwan’s special‑steel sector has already taken orders from aerospace, energy and oil‑gas sectors and is now further expanding into semiconductors, AI, liquid‑cooling and military‑industrial fields, the launch event also showcased a nearly 7‑meter‑long tank gun barrel “105 mm barrel” made from Ronggang’s alloy forging steel, demonstrating its capability to support an autonomous defense industry.

Moreover, driven by the AI wave, demand for easily machinable stainless steel from the semiconductor and vacuum industries is growing. Ronggang’s R&D team spent a year improving the EVERCUT brand, originally launched 30 years ago, to create EVERCUT+ and EVERCUT PLUS. By precisely adding sulfur and calcium during melting, the material chips more readily during turning, enhancing machining efficiency and meeting customer needs.

items.title: 離岸風電二期爆接管爭議！台電回擊富崴：依約接管且設備所有權屬台電
items.title_en: Offshore Wind Phase II Sparks Takeover Dispute! Taipower Rebuts Fuwei: Took Over per Contract and Owns the Equipment
paras: 離岸風電二期工程接管爭議持續升溫，針對富崴公司指控台電公司片面接管工程一事，台電於今（7) 日再次發表嚴正聲明強調，整起接管事件是因為富崴經營不善導致下包商Vestas失去信心並終止分包合約，富崴曾於6月3日與6月27日兩度主動請求台電接管，台電為了確保國家重大綠能建設順利完工，才依約接管後續風機安裝工程，並在公證人現場見證下完成點交，風機設備所有權已依法屬於台電所有，富崴所謂片面主張接管的說法實屬無端指控。
關於富崴公司違法違約設定風機動產抵押權一事，台電重申指出，依照雙方簽署的合約規定以及富崴自行簽署的承諾書內容，富崴非常清楚明白風機設備絕對不能設定動產抵押，卻仍違法違約進行設定。對此，台電已於9月21日正式發函要求富崴公司必須自行辦理註銷抵押權登記，並同步通知債權抵銷以保全台電的相關債權，更於10月5日正式向金管會提出檢舉，依法維護國營事業權益。
針對富崴及其母公司森崴能源 之借款爭議，台電進一步表示，截至目前為止，均未見森崴能源發布任何重大訊息，來揭露或說明該筆約61億元擔保債權之資金貸與或其他債權發生的事實及原因。台電認為，富崴公司與森崴能源理應秉持公開透明原則，具體向社會大眾及投資人說明該筆債權的發生原因、發生時間以及資金來源等關鍵細節。
至於富崴公司指控台電扣留保留款42.8億元的部分，台電強烈強調，本案早已依法依約支付高達9成的工程款項，從未有過任何拖欠行為，根本不存在所謂扣留保留款的情況。保留款制度是依據工程合約規定，必須等待整體工程完工且驗收合格之後才可以給付，這項規範在行政院公共工程委員會的標準契約範本中均有明確載明，屬於公共工程的基本規範，絕對不是針對富崴公司所訂定的特別規定。
台電補充說明，本案工程正是因為富崴公司未能依約履行責任，導致整體工程進度嚴重延宕，迄今尚未完成全部工程，更遑論達到驗收合格的標準，自然尚未達到可以請求給付保留款的法定與合約條件。針對富崴公司主張台電積欠款項等言論，台電直指對方顯然毫無法律常識，且意圖透過混淆視聽的方式來脫免其自身的違約責任。

台電再次向富崴公司發出嚴正要求，呼籲富崴應立即辦理相關風機動產抵押權之塗銷作業，並停止一切可能妨礙台電使用、安裝及管理風機設備的行為。台電強調，目前正全力推進離岸風電二期工程進度，在經由台電接手管理後，本周已再度完成1部風機的安裝作業，後續將持續穩定推進工程。對於富崴違法違約設定抵押及其他損害台電權益之行為，台電已經採取並將持續採取必要的法律措施，全力以完成風機安裝與併網發電為首要目標，以確保國家重大能源建設及全民利益。
paras_en: The dispute over the takeover of the offshore wind Phase II project continues to heat up. In response to Fuwei Corp.’s accusation that Taipower unilaterally seized the project, Taipower issued a stern statement today (the 7th), emphasizing that the takeover resulted from Fuwei’s mismanagement, which caused subcontractor Vestas to lose confidence and terminate its subcontract. Fuwei had voluntarily requested Taipower to take over on June 3 and June 27. To ensure the smooth completion of this major national green‑energy construction, Taipower assumed responsibility for the subsequent turbine installation as stipulated in the contract, completed the handover under the witness of a notary, and the ownership of the turbine equipment legally belongs to Taipower. Fuwei’s claim of a unilateral takeover is therefore unfounded.

Regarding Fuwei’s illegal and contract‑breaching creation of a movable‑property mortgage on the turbines, Taipower reiterated that, according to the signed contract and Fuwei’s own commitment letter, Fuwei was fully aware that the turbine equipment could not be mortgaged. Nevertheless, it proceeded to do so in violation of the agreement. Taipower formally sent a letter on September 21 demanding that Fuwei cancel the mortgage registration and simultaneously notify the creditor set‑off to protect Taipower’s related claims. On October 5, Taipower lodged a complaint with the Financial Supervisory Commission to legally safeguard the state‑owned enterprise’s rights.

Concerning the loan dispute involving Fuwei and its parent company Senwei Energy, Taipower further stated that, to date, Senwei Energy has not released any significant information disclosing or explaining the roughly NT$6.1 billion guaranteed debt, its funding source, or the circumstances of its occurrence. Taipower believes that Fuwei and Senwei Energy should adhere to the principles of openness and transparency, providing the public and investors with detailed explanations of the debt’s origin, timing, and financing.

As for Fuwei’s allegation that Taipower is withholding a retention amount of NT$4.28 billion, Taipower strongly emphasizes that the project has already paid up to 90 % of the contract price in accordance with the law and the agreement, with no instances of delayed payment. There is no such “withheld retention” situation. The retention system is stipulated by the construction contract and only becomes payable after the entire project is completed and passes acceptance, a rule clearly set out in the standard contract template of the Executive Yuan’s Public Construction Commission. It is a basic public‑construction provision, not a special rule targeting Fuwei.

Taipower added that the project’s severe delays are directly caused by Fuwei’s failure to fulfill its contractual obligations, resulting in the overall work not being finished, let alone meeting the acceptance criteria. Consequently, the legal and contractual conditions for claiming retention payments have not been met. Taipower labeled Fuwei’s claims of owed payments as legally baseless and an attempt to confuse the issue to evade its own breach of contract.

Taipower again issued a firm demand to Fuwei, urging it to immediately cancel the turbine mortgage and cease any actions that might impede Taipower’s use, installation, or management of the equipment. Taipower stressed that it is now fully advancing the offshore wind Phase II schedule; after taking over management, it completed the installation of another turbine this week and will continue to push the project forward steadily. Taipower has taken, and will continue to take, necessary legal measures against Fuwei’s illegal mortgage and other actions that harm Taipower’s rights, with the primary goal of completing turbine installation and grid connection to secure the nation’s major energy infrastructure and the public’s interest.

items.title: 油價又破百美元！30年期美債殖利率衝回24年高點
items.title_en: Oil Prices Break $100 Again! 30‑Year U.S. Treasury Yield Surges to 24‑Year High
paras: 美債賣壓再起，30年期美債殖利率回升至2002年以來最高水準，報5.72%。伊朗再度攻擊荷姆茲海峽船隻，推升布蘭特原油突破每桶102美元，加深市場對通膨加速及央行進一步升息的疑慮，也壓過部分投資人認為債市跌勢過頭、殖利率已具吸引力的看法。
據《彭博》周三(7日)報導，美債跌勢蔓延至歐洲，帶動英國30年期公債殖利率重返6%，法國同天期公債殖利率則一度攀升14個基點。政府財政赤字持續膨脹，加上中東戰事推升能源價格，已將多國公債殖利率推至數十年高點。
瑞穗國際多元資產策略師Evelyne Gomez-Liechti表示，市場仍陷於兩股力量拉鋸：一方面，目前殖利率水準具有吸引力；另一方面，油價帶來的壓力卻遲遲未退。
利率交換市場目前反映，聯準會(Fed)本月升息機率為24%，並已完全反映年底前升息一次的預期。交易員也擴大放空美債的部位，顯示這波拋售潮可能尚未結束。
近期殖利率上行，很大一部分來自期限溢酬攀升，也就是投資人持有長期債券所要求的額外報酬。這項指標自Fed9月會議後持續走高；彭博經濟研究數據顯示，截至周二，30年期美債期限溢酬已升至2011年以來最高。
美國銀行(BAC-US)利率策略師Ralf Preusser則表示，今年以來的債券熊市，主要反映市場重新評估央行政策走向。
paras_en: U.S. Treasury selling pressure has revived, pushing the 30‑year Treasury yield up to its highest level since 2002 at 5.72%. Iran’s renewed attacks on vessels in the Hormuz Strait have lifted Brent crude past $102 a barrel, deepening market concerns about accelerating inflation and further central‑bank rate hikes, and outweighing some investors’ view that the bond market’s decline is overdone and yields are already attractive.

According to Bloomberg on Wednesday the 7th, the U.S. bond sell‑off spread to Europe, sending the UK 30‑year gilt yield back above 6% and the French 30‑year gilt yield up by 14 basis points at one point. Expanding fiscal deficits and Middle‑East conflict‑driven energy price spikes have pushed many sovereign yields to multi‑decade highs.

Mizuho International multi‑asset strategist Evelyne Gomez‑Liechti said the market remains caught between two forces: on the one hand, current yield levels are attractive; on the other, the pressure from oil prices has yet to recede.

The interest‑rate swap market now reflects a 24% probability that the Fed will raise rates this month and fully prices in an expectation of one more hike by year‑end. Traders are also expanding short positions on U.S. Treasuries, indicating the sell‑off may not be over yet.

The recent upside in yields is largely driven by a rising term premium – the extra return investors demand for holding long‑dated bonds. This metric has been climbing since the Fed’s September meeting; Bloomberg Economic Research data show that as of Tuesday the 30‑year term premium has risen to its highest level since 2011.
Bank of America (BAC‑US) rate strategist Ralf Preusser said the bond bear market this year mainly reflects the market’s reassessment of central‑bank policy direction.

items.title: 10年期美債殖利率創24年新高 市場聚焦390億美元標售
items.title_en: 10-Year US Treasury Yield Hits 24-Year High, Market Focuses on $39 Billion Auction
paras: 美債殖利率周三(7日)攀升，指標10年期美債殖利率升至2002年以來最高水準。市場聚焦美國財政部即將標售的390億美元10年期公債，觀察在通膨、債務與長期持債風險疑慮下，目前殖利率是否足以吸引買盤。
10年期美債殖利率上升近8個基點至5.35%，30年期上升8.3個基點至5.724%，2年期則上升2.7個基點至4.818%。債券價格與殖利率呈反向變動。
此次10年期公債標售結果將於美東時間下午1時公布，是本周三場標售中的第二場。財政部周二已售出580億美元3年期公債，周四還將標售220億美元30年期公債。
蒙特婁銀行(BMO-US)美國利率策略主管Ian Lyngen表示，周二3年期公債標售需求令人鼓舞，得標殖利率略低於標售前市場交易水準，扭轉近期附息公債標售結果偏弱的情況。
不過，BMO認為，10年期公債標售對美債利率走勢更具指標性，預期標售前仍需透過價格下跌、殖利率上升，或相對其他天期債券變得更便宜，吸引投資人承接。
財政部周四也將回購剩餘期限20至30年的公債，以支援市場流動性，規模至少40億美元，為正常規模兩倍；上次同期限區間的回購金額略逾40億美元。
通膨與能源漲價疑慮持續壓抑債市。自7月底以來，10年期美債殖利率已攀升60個基點，同期美國原油價格大漲20%。歐洲債市也承壓，法國10年期公債殖利率上升12個基點至4.876%，英國同天期殖利率上升7個基點至5.447%。
市場另關注美東時間下午2時公布的聯準會(Fed)9月會議紀錄，尋找2023年以來首次升息後的政策線索。紐約聯準銀行上午11時公布的消費者預期調查，也將提供未來1年、3年與5年的通膨預期。
paras_en: US Treasury yields rose on Wednesday (the 7th), with the benchmark 10-year yield climbing to its highest level since 2002. The market is focusing on the Treasury’s upcoming $39 billion auction of 10-year notes, watching whether yields are high enough to attract buyers amid inflation, debt and long‑term holding‑risk concerns.
The 10-year yield rose about 8 basis points to 5.35%, the 30-year rose 8.3 basis points to 5.724%, and the 2-year rose 2.7 basis points to 4.818%. Bond prices move inversely to yields.

The result of the 10-year auction will be announced at 1 p.m. Eastern Time; it is the second auction of the week. The Treasury sold $58 billion of 3‑year notes on Tuesday and will auction $22 billion of 30‑year notes on Thursday.

Ian Lyngen, head of US rate strategy at BMO‑US, said demand for Tuesday’s 3‑year auction was encouraging, with the awarded yield slightly below the pre‑auction market level, reversing the recent weakness seen in coupon‑bearing note auctions.

However, BMO believes the 10‑year auction is more indicative of the direction of US Treasury rates and expects that, before the auction, prices will need to fall and yields rise—or the notes will need to become relatively cheaper than other maturities—to attract investors.

The Treasury will also repurchase remaining 20‑ to 30‑year bonds on Thursday to support market liquidity, with a size of at least $4 billion—twice the normal amount; the last repurchase in that maturity range was just over $4 billion.

Inflation and energy‑price concerns continue to weigh on the bond market. Since the end of July, the 10‑year yield has risen 60 basis points, while US crude oil prices have jumped about 20%. European bonds are also under pressure, with France’s 10‑year yield up 12 basis points to 4.876% and the UK’s 10‑year yield up 7 basis points to 5.447%.

The market is also watching for the Fed’s September meeting minutes, to be released at 2 p.m. Eastern Time, for clues after the first rate hike since 2023, and the New York Fed’s consumer expectations survey released at 11 a.m., which will provide inflation expectations for the next 1, 3 and 5 years.

items.title: 微軟、輝達CEO將親自站台 共推新款AI筆電 宣告「本地AI代理」時代來臨
items.title_en: Microsoft and Nvidia CEOs to Appear in Person to Launch New AI Laptop, Announcing the Era of "Local AI Agents"
paras: 分析師指出，微軟(MSFT-US)將於周三(7日)發表一款搭載輝達(NVDA-US)晶片的新筆記型電腦。此舉旨在將 Windows 打造為一個平台，讓 AI 代理(AI agents)能夠在無需存取雲端的情況下，處理編寫程式碼等任務。
微軟將在舊金山舉辦此次發表會，官方稱之為關於 Windows 作業系統及 Surface 硬體系列的更新發布。發表會上，預計由微軟執行長 Satya Nadella 與輝達執行長黃仁勳親自揭曉這款旗艦級筆電 Surface Laptop Ultra。
這款裝置搭載輝達與聯發科合作開發的 Arm 架構 RTX Spark 系統單晶片，並讓 AI 代理不必連線至雲端資料中心，即可直接在本地端執行撰寫程式碼或處理複雜商業專案等任務。
此策略有助於減輕微軟 Azure 資料中心的運算壓力，並在傳統由英特爾(INTC-US)與超微(AMD-US)主導的 Windows 個人電腦市場中，搶占邊緣運算先機，直接對標蘋果(AAPL-US)的 Mac 系列產品。
硬體配置方面，Surface Laptop Ultra 推出兩種版本，入門款搭載 18 核心 CPU 與 24GB 統一記憶體，高階款則配備 20 核心 CPU，記憶體最高可擴充至 128GB。螢幕採用 15 吋 mini-LED 觸控螢幕，輝達宣稱 RTX Spark 具備 1 Petaflop 的 FP4 AI 運算效能，且無論是否連接電源都能維持幾乎相同的效能輸出。
然而，價格成為該款筆電推廣的最大挑戰。受全球記憶體晶片短缺影響，高容量記憶體成本大幅攀升。市場預估 Surface Laptop Ultra 起售價將超過 2,000 美元，頂規 128GB 版本價格甚至可能高達 7,000 至 8,000 美元。
Moor Insights & Strategy 分析師 Anshel Sag表示，兩年前，軟體還沒準備好，但硬體準備好了。現在軟體準備好了，但硬體太貴，無法在本地運行，恐使本地端 AI 運算設備暫時成為僅有高預算買家才能負擔的奢華產品。
paras_en: Analysts note that Microsoft (MSFT-US) will unveil on Wednesday (the 7th) a new laptop powered by an Nvidia (NVDA-US) chip. The move aims to make Windows a platform where AI agents can perform tasks such as code writing without needing to access the cloud.

Microsoft will hold the launch in San Francisco, officially described as an update release for the Windows operating system and the Surface hardware lineup. The event is expected to feature Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella and Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang personally unveiling the flagship Surface Laptop Ultra.

The device is equipped with an Arm‑based RTX Spark system‑on‑chip co‑developed by Nvidia and MediaTek, allowing AI agents to run locally—writing code or handling complex business projects—without connecting to a cloud data center.

The strategy helps relieve computing pressure on Microsoft Azure data centers and aims to capture edge‑computing opportunities in the Windows PC market traditionally dominated by Intel (INTC-US) and AMD (AMD-US), directly challenging Apple’s (AAPL-US) Mac lineup.

In terms of hardware, the Surface Laptop Ultra will be offered in two configurations: a base model with an 18‑core CPU and 24 GB of unified memory, and a premium model with a 20‑core CPU and memory expandable up to 128 GB. It sports a 15‑inch mini‑LED touch display, and Nvidia claims the RTX Spark delivers 1 petaflop of FP4 AI performance, maintaining nearly identical output whether or not the laptop is plugged in.

However, price is the biggest hurdle for the laptop’s adoption. Global memory‑chip shortages have driven up the cost of high‑capacity RAM sharply. Market estimates put the starting price of the Surface Laptop Ultra above $2,000, with the top‑spec 128 GB version potentially costing $7,000 to $8,000.

Moor Insights & Strategy analyst Anshel Sag said that two years ago the software wasn’t ready but the hardware was; now the software is ready but the hardware is too expensive to run locally, risking that on‑premise AI compute devices will remain a luxury only affordable to high‑budget buyers.

items.title: 東航空姐下跪事件延燒 乘客是上市公司董事長？萬年青製藥回應
items.title_en: China Eastern Flight Attendant Kneeling Incident Escalates; Passenger Allegedly Chairman of Listed Company? Wan Nianqing Pharma Responds
paras: 東航(CEA-US) (00670-HK) 空姐下跪事件延燒，廣東萬年青製藥公司7日（周三）發布關於網路不實訊息侵害公司及相關人員名譽的聲明。
萬年青製藥公司表示，近日部分網路平台流傳「9月28日東航MU6741航班客艙衝突事件涉事旅客為廣東萬年青製藥股份有限公司董事長歐先濤先生」的內容，引發關注熱議。
萬年青製藥公司說，經公司核實，該內容與事實嚴重不符，歐先濤先生及公司其他員工從未乘坐該航班，上述訊息是惡意捏造，已侵害公司董事長個人名譽及公司商業信譽。
萬年青製藥公司稱，針對上述侵權行為，歐先濤先生已向公安機關報案，並獲受理，公司也同步就相關傳播內容展開證據留存與保全工作。公司將根據法律法規對造謠者及惡意傳播者追究全部法律責任。
上月29日一則「航班乘務員下跪」的帖子在社交平台流傳。
帖子稱，一架由合肥飛往大連的航班上，一名乘務員（空服員）推餐車時碰到旅客手肘並道歉，該旅客仍表示不滿，並提出「要嘛讓我踹一腳」等要求。
隨後乘務員哭泣、下跪，安全員介入，旅客還要求乘務長（座艙長）和涉事乘務員下班後陪同其前往醫院檢查。
據《極目新聞》報導，該網友張先生稱28日晚9時許，他乘坐從合肥到大連的航班，途中拍到上述一幕，「當時空姐跪了兩三次，挺久的，我沒有錄到全程影片」。
「餐車移動速度不快，那個被撞的男子沒出血，乘務長也拿來冰袋敷著，應該不嚴重。」張先生表示，後來該男子要求下機帶他去醫院檢查。
媒體報導後不久，張先生刪除上述影片，他說「電話被打爆了」。
東航對此表示，經核實，航班乘務員在推餐車提供飲料服務過程中，全程提示旅客注意，一名旅客處於睡眠狀態，不慎造成餐車與其手肘發生觸碰。
乘務員當即反覆致歉，查看旅客狀況。該旅客情緒激動，連續使用粗俗過激言語，並出現威脅腳踢乘務員、要求當事乘務員落地後陪同就醫等言行，該乘務員受到驚嚇。
為維護飛行安全和客艙秩序，乘務長、安全員迅速介入協同處置。航班落地後，醫護人員上機檢查旅客未有明顯外傷或腫脹、無須進一步處理，旅客拒絕地面人員陪同送醫，自行離開。
東航說，事件發生後，第一時間對當事乘務員展開心理疏導與關懷支持，該員工已恢復正常工作。在此，對關心支持民航一線員工的旅客、公眾表示感謝。
paras_en: China Eastern Airlines (CEA-US) (00670-HK) flight attendant kneeling incident continues to flare up, and Guangdong Wan Nianqing Pharmaceutical Company issued a statement on Wednesday the 7th regarding false online information that harmed the reputation of the company and related personnel.

Wan Nianqing Pharmaceutical said that recent posts on some online platforms claimed that the passenger involved in the September 28 cabin conflict on China Eastern MU6741 was Mr. Ou Xiantao, chairman of Guangdong Wan Nianqing Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd., sparking heated discussion.

The company stated that after verification, the claim is seriously inconsistent with facts; Mr. Ou and other employees never boarded that flight, the information is a malicious fabrication that has damaged the chairman’s personal reputation and the company’s commercial credibility.

Wan Nianqing said that regarding the infringement, Mr. Ou has reported the matter to public security authorities, which have accepted the case, and the company is simultaneously preserving evidence of the related content. The company will pursue full legal liability against the rumor‑mongers and malicious disseminators in accordance with laws and regulations.
A post about a "flight attendant kneeling" circulated on social media on the 29th of last month.

The post claimed that on a flight from Hefei to Dalian, a crew member (flight attendant) bumped a passenger’s elbow while pushing a trolley, apologized, but the passenger remained dissatisfied and demanded, among other things, "let me kick you".
Subsequently the crew member cried and knelt, a safety officer intervened, and the passenger also demanded that the purser and the involved crew member accompany him to a hospital after the flight.

According to Jimu News, the netizen Mr. Zhang said that around 9 p.m. on the 28th he was on the Hefei‑Dalian flight and captured the scene, noting "the flight attendant knelt two or three times, for quite a while; I didn’t record the whole video."

Mr. Zhang added, "The trolley wasn’t moving fast, the man who was hit didn’t bleed, the purser applied an ice pack, so it shouldn’t be serious." He later said the man requested to deplane and be taken to a hospital for examination.
Shortly after the media report, Mr. Zhang deleted the video, saying his phone was "bombarded with calls."

China Eastern said that after verification, during the beverage service the crew member repeatedly reminded passengers to be careful; a passenger who was asleep inadvertently caused the trolley to brush his elbow.

The crew member immediately apologized repeatedly and checked the passenger’s condition. The passenger became emotionally agitated, used vulgar and aggressive language, threatened to kick the crew member and demanded that the crew accompany him to a hospital after landing, which frightened the crew member.

To maintain flight safety and cabin order, the purser and safety officer promptly intervened and coordinated a response. After landing, medical staff inspected the passenger and found no obvious injuries or swelling, requiring no further treatment; the passenger refused ground staff accompaniment to a hospital and left on his own.

China Eastern said that after the incident, it promptly provided psychological counseling and support to the involved crew member, who has now returned to normal duties, and expressed gratitude to the passengers and public for their concern and support for frontline civil‑aviation staff.

items.title: Fed會議紀錄將揭升息分歧 市場押注10月按兵不動
items.title_en: Fed Meeting Minutes Expected to Reveal Rate‑Hike Split; Market Bets on No Move in October
paras: 聯準會(Fed)將於美東時間周三(7日)下午2時、周四(8日)凌晨2時公布9月會議紀錄，可能揭露決策官員在全員一致升息背後，對後續政策路徑的不同看法。隨著近期通膨與就業數據低於預期，市場已轉向押注10月按兵不動，紀錄將有助釐清官員對持續緊縮的支持程度。
Fed在9月15至16日會議升息1碼，將政策利率調至3.75%至4.00%。主席華許當時表示，此舉旨在收回「部分寬鬆」，因為通膨似乎停滯於2%目標之上，現行政策對整體經濟的抑制作用卻相當有限。
這次行動也被視為兌現華許夏末的鷹派表態。他曾承諾將以「足夠快的速度」降低通膨，即使必須升息，與川普要求降低借貸成本的立場背道而馳。

全員一致升息 後續緊縮步調仍有分歧

不過，支持9月升息，不代表官員對下一步具有共識。會議紀錄可能呈現兩派分歧：一派認為通膨壓力強勁且持久，需要持續緊縮；另一派則傾向耐心等待，直到新數據證明有必要再度升息。
花旗(C-US)分析師預期，儘管官員廣泛支持當次決策，對未來政策仍抱持不同看法。紐約聯準銀行總裁威廉斯主張較有耐心，達拉斯聯準銀行總裁蘿根則認為，至少還需再升息兩次、每次1碼，才能控制通膨。
花旗也預期，部分官員可能不認同華許所稱經濟強勁到升息「不會造成傷害」的描述，並可能認為會前公布的通膨數據已出現「令人鼓舞」的訊號。

通膨就業數據降溫 市場轉押10月按兵不動

9月會後公布的利率預測顯示，提交預測的18名官員中，有16人預估今年還會再升息一次。不過，隨後公布的8月通膨漲幅低於預期，9月就業成長也不如預期，促使市場重新評估緊縮步調。
投資人在9月會後原本預期，Fed會在10月與12月兩次會議接連升息。但兼任聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)副主席的威廉斯表示，決定何時再升息「不必急於一時」，Fed副主席傑佛森也表達類似看法，帶動市場預期轉變。
目前，投資人壓倒性預期Fed將於10月27至28日會議維持利率不變，這場會議距離美國期中選舉不到一周。華許則遵循減少政策前瞻指引的承諾，自9月16日會後記者會以來，未再公開發言。
下次會議前，Fed將取得9月消費者物價指數(CPI)，也將掌握足夠資料，推估作為2%通膨目標依據的9月個人消費支出物價指數(PCE)通膨率，為下一步決策提供線索。
paras_en: The Federal Reserve will release the minutes of its September meeting at 2 p.m. Eastern time on Wednesday, July 7, and again at 2 a.m. Eastern on Thursday, July 8. The minutes may expose differing views among policymakers about the path forward after a unanimous rate hike. With recent inflation and employment data coming in below expectations, markets have shifted to betting that the Fed will hold rates steady in October, and the minutes should clarify how strongly officials support continued tightening.

The Fed raised rates by one quarter‑point at its September 15‑16 meeting, moving the target range to 3.75 %‑4.00 %. Chair Jerome Powell said the move was intended to roll back “some of the excesses” because inflation appeared to be stuck above the 2 % goal, while the current policy’s drag on the overall economy was still relatively modest.

The action was also seen as a fulfillment of Powell’s hawkish statements from late summer. He had pledged to bring inflation down “at a sufficiently fast pace,” even if it required further hikes, a stance at odds with former President Trump’s demand to lower borrowing costs.

Unanimous Rate Hike, Yet Divergence on Future Tightening

However, backing the September hike does not mean officials agree on the next step. The minutes may show a split: one camp believes inflation pressures remain strong and persistent, warranting continued tightening; the other prefers to wait patiently until new data justify another hike.

Citigroup (C‑US) analysts expect that, although officials broadly supported the September decision, they hold differing views on future policy. New York Fed President John Williams advocates a more patient approach, while Dallas Fed President Lorie Kroger argues that at least two more 25‑basis‑point hikes are needed to bring inflation under control.

Citigroup also anticipates that some officials may disagree with Powell’s characterization of the economy as strong enough that a rate hike “won’t cause harm,” and may see the inflation data released before the meeting as showing “encouraging” signals.

Cooling Inflation and Employment Data Prompt Market Shift to a Hold in October

The post‑meeting rate forecasts showed that of the 18 officials who submitted projections, 16 expected one more hike this year. Yet the subsequently released August inflation numbers came in lower than expected, and September job growth also lagged, leading markets to reassess the pace of tightening.

Investors had originally expected the Fed to raise rates at both the October and December meetings after the September session. But FOMC Vice Chair Williams said the timing of any further hike “does not have to be rushed,” and Vice Chair for Supervision Michael Jefferson echoed the sentiment, prompting a shift in market expectations.

Currently, investors overwhelmingly anticipate that the Fed will leave rates unchanged at its October 27‑28 meeting, which comes less than a week before the U.S. midterm elections. Powell, adhering to his pledge to reduce forward guidance, has not spoken publicly since the September 16 press conference.

Before the next meeting, the Fed will receive September’s Consumer Price Index (CPI) and will have enough data to estimate the September Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) inflation rate, the metric used to gauge progress toward the 2 % inflation target, providing clues for its next policy move.

items.title: 馬斯克澄清：排除台積電主導Terafab營運 英特爾利多
items.title_en: Musk Clarifies: No TSMC Control Over Terafab Operations, Intel Gains
paras: 特斯拉(TSLA-US)與 SpaceX(SPCX-US) 執行長馬斯克(Elon Musk)周三(7日)於社群平台 X 上明確表示，其商業帝國將獨立建造並營運位於德州格蘭姆斯郡(Grimes County)的 Terafab 人工智慧(AI)晶片廠，徹底排除台積電(TSM-US)(2330-TW)接管營運的可能性。
馬斯克強調，對於台積電的潛在合作僅限於可能轉租場地的部分區域，不會涉及任何營運角色。
Terafab 為特斯拉與 SpaceXAI 的合資項目，初期投資額為 168 億美元，總潛在支出高達 1,190 億美元，預計聘用至少 3,000 名員工。
工廠目標為每年提供超過 1 兆瓦(terawatt)的 AI 計算能力，用於供應馬斯克事業體所需的先進晶片，涵蓋特斯拉 Optimus 機器人、Cybercab 無人計程車、SpaceX 太空資料中心以及 xAI 的 Grok AI 模型。
此聲明對英特爾(INTC-US)而言為一大利多。英特爾於 4 月成為 Terafab 唯一指定的製造合作夥伴，其下一代 14A 製程技術為工廠目前唯一採用的技術。英特爾執行長陳立武已證實公司將持續參與計畫。
在馬斯克澄清後，英特爾美股盤前上漲 1.6%，而台積電 ADR 則下跌 1.3%。鑑於英特爾第二季外部晶圓代工營收僅 2.93 億美元，Terafab 項目已成為其發展晶圓代工業務的關鍵。
paras_en: Tesla (TSLA-US) and SpaceX (SPCX-US) CEO Elon Musk said on Wednesday (the 7th) on the X platform that his business empire will independently build and operate the Terafab AI chip plant in Grimes County, Texas, completely ruling out any possibility of TSMC (TSM-US) (2330-TW) taking over operations.
Musk emphasized that any potential cooperation with TSMC would be limited to possibly sub‑leasing parts of the site and would not involve any operational role.

Terafab is a joint venture between Tesla and SpaceX AI, with an initial investment of $16.8 billion and total potential spending of up to $119 billion, and it is expected to employ at least 3,000 people.

The factory aims to deliver more than 1 terawatt of AI compute capacity per year to supply advanced chips for Musk’s enterprises, including the Tesla Optimus robot, the Cybercab autonomous taxi, SpaceX’s space data center, and xAI’s Grok AI model.

The statement is a major tailwind for Intel (INTC-US). In April, Intel became the sole designated manufacturing partner for Terafab, and its next‑generation 14A process is the only technology the plant will use. Intel CEO Pat Gelsinger has confirmed the company will continue to participate in the project.

After Musk’s clarification, Intel’s U.S. shares rose 1.6% in pre‑market trading, while TSMC ADR fell 1.3%. Given Intel’s Q2 external foundry revenue of only $293 million, the Terafab project has become a key driver for its foundry business development.

items.title: AI需求爆發！三星Q3本業獲利估衝上九倍高 記憶體漲勢卻開始放緩
items.title_en: AI Demand Booms! Samsung's Q3 Core Profit Estimated to Surge Nearly Ninefold, Memory Price Gains Slow
paras: 三星電子預定周四(8日)公布初步財報，分析師預估在人工智慧(AI)需求帶動下，第3季營業利益將躍增至去年的將近九倍。
儘管記憶體晶片價格漲勢趨緩，加上韓元走強，全球最大記憶體晶片製造商三星電子第3季(7至9月)營業利益預估達106.1兆韓元(791億美元)，是去年同期12.17兆韓元的將近九倍，且為連續第四季創下歷史新高，凸顯記憶體供應持續短缺，AI基礎建設供不應求。
然而路孚特(LSEG)SmartEstimate綜合21位分析師的預測值，自8月底以來已調降7.7%。三星將在10月底公布完整財報數據。
多家晶片製造商預期，這波始於一年多前的記憶體短缺將持續至明年，甚至可能延續到2028年。但記憶體價格漲幅在第3季有所放緩，引發市場對晶片利潤率可能已經觸頂的疑慮，也讓外界開始質疑AI支出熱潮能否持續。
三星目前股價雖比6月創下的歷史高點低了約25%，但仍較今年初水準高出逾一倍。

記憶體漲勢放緩 成本壓力升高

晶片價格上漲不但推高智慧手機與消費電子產品成本，還進一步對需求造成壓力。與此同時，晶片製造商與客戶簽訂的長期供應協議，在確保供應的同時，也限制了價格漲幅。
研調機構集邦科技(TrendForce)預期，第4季傳統DRAM合約價格將較前季上漲10%至15%，低於第2季約60%的漲幅。
TrendForce研究資深副總裁Avril Wu說：「儘管市場供應仍處於吃緊狀態，但價格成長速度預料將放緩。」她補充指出，供應商擔心進一步大幅調漲價格，可能傷害廣泛消費電子產品的需求。
Wu說：「此外，長期協議占供應商總產出的比重持續提高。由於合約中納入價格上限機制，價格漲幅已經有所放緩。」
三星7月表示，計劃確保長約涵蓋約三分之二的記憶體產量，呼應競爭對手為了降低業界景氣循環影響所做的舉措。
美國同業美光表示，2027年與2028年的晶片市場可能比今年更加吃緊，但預估單季毛利率將從87%降至86.3%，部分原因是員工薪酬成本增加。

三星面臨韓元升值與中國競爭

SK證券分析師Han Dong-hee預估，三星第3季記憶體晶片的營業利益率預料達76%，與前季持平。
三星也面臨來自中國競爭對手日益升高的競爭。雖然中國業者供應的多為偏低階產品，但也在AI帶動的記憶體供應短缺中受益。
Summit Insights Group資深研究分析師Kinngai Chan說：「我們的產業調查顯示，越來越多OEM與ODM正在採用中國製DRAM與NAND。」
匯率波動則是另一項不利因素。韓元兌美元第3季升值14.3%，從17年低點大幅反彈，創下1998年初以來最大的單季升幅。當韓元升值，代表海外獲利匯回時的價值將降低。
隨著三星縮小與市場龍頭SK海力士之間的差距，市場預期三星將提升高頻寬記憶體(HBM)晶片銷售。摩根大通(JP Morgan)預估，三星今年HBM市占率預料將從去年的20%升至34%，SK海力士市占率則預估從60%降至46%。
paras_en: Samsung Electronics is scheduled to release preliminary earnings on Thursday (the 8th), with analysts forecasting that operating profit for Q3 will jump to almost nine times that of the previous year, driven by AI demand.

Even though memory chip price increases are easing and the won is strengthening, Samsung Electronics, the world’s largest memory chip maker, estimates Q3 (July‑September) operating profit at 106.1 trillion won (US$79.1 billion), roughly nine times the 12.17 trillion won of the same period last year, marking a fourth consecutive quarter of record highs and underscoring continued memory shortages and excess AI infrastructure demand.
However, LSEG’s SmartEstimate, which aggregates forecasts from 21 analysts, has cut its estimate by 7.7% since the end of August. Samsung will release full earnings data at the end of October.

Several chip makers expect the memory shortage that began over a year ago to persist into next year and possibly through 2028. Yet the slowdown in memory price gains in Q3 has sparked market doubts that chip margins may have peaked, raising questions about the durability of the AI spending surge.
Samsung’s share price is about 25% below the historic high set in June, but still more than double its level at the start of the year.

Memory price gains are slowing, raising cost pressure. Higher chip prices have lifted costs for smartphones and consumer electronics, further pressuring demand. At the same time, long‑term supply agreements between manufacturers and customers secure supply while capping price hikes.
TrendForce expects traditional DRAM contract prices in Q4 to rise 10‑15% from the prior quarter, far below the roughly 60% increase seen in Q2.

TrendForce senior research VP Avril Wu said, “Although market supply remains tight, price growth is expected to slow.” She added that suppliers fear further steep price hikes could damage demand for a broad range of consumer electronics.
Wu noted, “In addition, the share of long‑term contracts in total output is rising. Because contracts include price‑cap mechanisms, price increases have already moderated.”
In July, Samsung said it plans to ensure that long‑term contracts cover about two‑thirds of its memory production, echoing competitors’ moves to blunt the impact of industry cycles.
U.S. rival Micron said the chip market in 2027‑28 may be tighter than this year, but it forecasts quarterly gross margins to fall from 87% to 86.3%, partly due to higher employee compensation costs.
Samsung faces a stronger won and rising competition from China. SK Securities analyst Han Dong‑hee projects Samsung’s Q3 memory chip operating margin at 76%, flat with the prior quarter.
Samsung also confronts growing competition from Chinese rivals. While Chinese firms mainly supply lower‑end products, they are also benefiting from AI‑driven memory shortages.
Summit Insights Group senior analyst Kinngai Chan said, “Our industry survey shows an increasing number of OEMs and ODMs are adopting Chinese‑made DRAM and NAND.”

Currency fluctuations are another headwind. The won appreciated 14.3% against the dollar in Q3, rebounding sharply from its 2017 low and marking the biggest quarterly gain since early 1998. A stronger won reduces the value of overseas profits when repatriated.

As Samsung narrows the gap with market leader SK Hynix, the market expects Samsung to boost sales of high‑bandwidth memory (HBM) chips. JP Morgan forecasts Samsung’s HBM market share to rise from 20% last year to 34% this year, while SK Hynix’s share is expected to fall from 60% to 46%.

items.title: SpaceX擴大AI採購，傳擬募資400億美元採購輝達晶片
items.title_en: SpaceX expands AI procurement, plans to raise $40 billion to purchase NVIDIA chips
paras: 2026年10月07日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ SpaceX與輝達NVIDIA(NVDA-US)的合作關係可能進一步升溫。據《金融時報》報導，SpaceX正籌措400億美元資金，用於採購輝達AI晶片，其中約100億美元來自銀行貸款，另外300億美元則規畫透過投資級債券籌集。
這筆資金若順利到位，將支應SpaceX旗下xAI持續擴大AI基礎設施。馬斯克近期表示，位於美國孟菲斯的Colossus資料中心，年底前輝達晶片數量可能增至144萬顆，並曾表示SpaceX將全面採用輝達AI晶片。
市場對SpaceX AI業務的收入預期也持續上修。SpaceX旗下AI業務2027年營收預估已由7月時的380億美元提高至600億美元；到2031年，市場預估AI相關營收可達5,300億美元。
輝達股價近期持續創高，市值逼近6兆美元。SpaceX盤前股價下跌1.7%至169美元，輝達則上漲0.3%至239.99美元。

paras_en: October 7, 2026 (You Analysis/Industry Data Center reporting) – SpaceX’s partnership with NVIDIA (NVDA-US) may heat up further. According to the Financial Times, SpaceX is raising $40 billion to buy NVIDIA AI chips, about $10 billion of which will come from bank loans and the remaining $30 billion planned to be raised via investment‑grade bonds.

If the funding comes through, it will support SpaceX’s subsidiary xAI in continuing to expand its AI infrastructure. Elon Musk recently said that the Colossus data center in Memphis, USA could have as many as 1.44 million NVIDIA chips by year‑end, and he has stated that SpaceX will fully adopt NVIDIA AI chips.

Market expectations for SpaceX’s AI business revenue are also being revised upward. Revenue for SpaceX’s AI segment in 2027 is now projected at $60 billion, up from the July estimate of $38 billion; by 2031, the market foresees AI‑related revenue could reach $530 billion.
NVIDIA’s share price has been hitting new highs, with a market value approaching $6 trillion. SpaceX’s pre‑market stock fell 1.7% to $169, while NVIDIA rose 0.3% to $239.99.

items.title: 油價又破百美元！30年期美債殖利率衝回24年高點
items.title_en: Oil Prices Break $100 Again! 30‑Year U.S. Treasury Yield Surges to 24‑Year High
paras: 美債賣壓再起，30年期美債殖利率回升至2002年以來最高水準，報5.72%。伊朗再度攻擊荷姆茲海峽船隻，推升布蘭特原油突破每桶102美元，加深市場對通膨加速及央行進一步升息的疑慮，也壓過部分投資人認為債市跌勢過頭、殖利率已具吸引力的看法。
據《彭博》周三(7日)報導，美債跌勢蔓延至歐洲，帶動英國30年期公債殖利率重返6%，法國同天期公債殖利率則一度攀升14個基點。政府財政赤字持續膨脹，加上中東戰事推升能源價格，已將多國公債殖利率推至數十年高點。
瑞穗國際多元資產策略師Evelyne Gomez-Liechti表示，市場仍陷於兩股力量拉鋸：一方面，目前殖利率水準具有吸引力；另一方面，油價帶來的壓力卻遲遲未退。
利率交換市場目前反映，聯準會(Fed)本月升息機率為24%，並已完全反映年底前升息一次的預期。交易員也擴大放空美債的部位，顯示這波拋售潮可能尚未結束。
近期殖利率上行，很大一部分來自期限溢酬攀升，也就是投資人持有長期債券所要求的額外報酬。這項指標自Fed9月會議後持續走高；彭博經濟研究數據顯示，截至周二，30年期美債期限溢酬已升至2011年以來最高。
美國銀行(BAC-US)利率策略師Ralf Preusser則表示，今年以來的債券熊市，主要反映市場重新評估央行政策走向。
paras_en: U.S. Treasury selling pressure has revived, pushing the 30‑year Treasury yield up to its highest level since 2002 at 5.72%. Iran’s renewed attacks on vessels in the Hormuz Strait have lifted Brent crude past $102 a barrel, deepening market concerns about accelerating inflation and further central‑bank rate hikes, and outweighing some investors’ view that the bond market’s decline is overdone and yields are already attractive.

According to Bloomberg on Wednesday the 7th, the U.S. bond sell‑off spread to Europe, sending the UK 30‑year gilt yield back above 6% and the French 30‑year gilt yield up by 14 basis points at one point. Expanding fiscal deficits and Middle‑East conflict‑driven energy price spikes have pushed many sovereign yields to multi‑decade highs.

Mizuho International multi‑asset strategist Evelyne Gomez‑Liechti said the market remains caught between two forces: on the one hand, current yield levels are attractive; on the other, the pressure from oil prices has yet to recede.

The interest‑rate swap market now reflects a 24% probability that the Fed will raise rates this month and fully prices in an expectation of one more hike by year‑end. Traders are also expanding short positions on U.S. Treasuries, indicating the sell‑off may not be over yet.

The recent upside in yields is largely driven by a rising term premium – the extra return investors demand for holding long‑dated bonds. This metric has been climbing since the Fed’s September meeting; Bloomberg Economic Research data show that as of Tuesday the 30‑year term premium has risen to its highest level since 2011.
Bank of America (BAC‑US) rate strategist Ralf Preusser said the bond bear market this year mainly reflects the market’s reassessment of central‑bank policy direction.

items.title: 10年期美債殖利率創24年新高 市場聚焦390億美元標售
items.title_en: 10-Year US Treasury Yield Hits 24-Year High, Market Focuses on $39 Billion Auction
paras: 美債殖利率周三(7日)攀升，指標10年期美債殖利率升至2002年以來最高水準。市場聚焦美國財政部即將標售的390億美元10年期公債，觀察在通膨、債務與長期持債風險疑慮下，目前殖利率是否足以吸引買盤。
10年期美債殖利率上升近8個基點至5.35%，30年期上升8.3個基點至5.724%，2年期則上升2.7個基點至4.818%。債券價格與殖利率呈反向變動。
此次10年期公債標售結果將於美東時間下午1時公布，是本周三場標售中的第二場。財政部周二已售出580億美元3年期公債，周四還將標售220億美元30年期公債。
蒙特婁銀行(BMO-US)美國利率策略主管Ian Lyngen表示，周二3年期公債標售需求令人鼓舞，得標殖利率略低於標售前市場交易水準，扭轉近期附息公債標售結果偏弱的情況。
不過，BMO認為，10年期公債標售對美債利率走勢更具指標性，預期標售前仍需透過價格下跌、殖利率上升，或相對其他天期債券變得更便宜，吸引投資人承接。
財政部周四也將回購剩餘期限20至30年的公債，以支援市場流動性，規模至少40億美元，為正常規模兩倍；上次同期限區間的回購金額略逾40億美元。
通膨與能源漲價疑慮持續壓抑債市。自7月底以來，10年期美債殖利率已攀升60個基點，同期美國原油價格大漲20%。歐洲債市也承壓，法國10年期公債殖利率上升12個基點至4.876%，英國同天期殖利率上升7個基點至5.447%。
市場另關注美東時間下午2時公布的聯準會(Fed)9月會議紀錄，尋找2023年以來首次升息後的政策線索。紐約聯準銀行上午11時公布的消費者預期調查，也將提供未來1年、3年與5年的通膨預期。
paras_en: US Treasury yields rose on Wednesday (the 7th), with the benchmark 10-year yield climbing to its highest level since 2002. The market is focusing on the Treasury’s upcoming $39 billion auction of 10-year notes, watching whether yields are high enough to attract buyers amid inflation, debt and long‑term holding‑risk concerns.
The 10-year yield rose about 8 basis points to 5.35%, the 30-year rose 8.3 basis points to 5.724%, and the 2-year rose 2.7 basis points to 4.818%. Bond prices move inversely to yields.

The result of the 10-year auction will be announced at 1 p.m. Eastern Time; it is the second auction of the week. The Treasury sold $58 billion of 3‑year notes on Tuesday and will auction $22 billion of 30‑year notes on Thursday.

Ian Lyngen, head of US rate strategy at BMO‑US, said demand for Tuesday’s 3‑year auction was encouraging, with the awarded yield slightly below the pre‑auction market level, reversing the recent weakness seen in coupon‑bearing note auctions.

However, BMO believes the 10‑year auction is more indicative of the direction of US Treasury rates and expects that, before the auction, prices will need to fall and yields rise—or the notes will need to become relatively cheaper than other maturities—to attract investors.

The Treasury will also repurchase remaining 20‑ to 30‑year bonds on Thursday to support market liquidity, with a size of at least $4 billion—twice the normal amount; the last repurchase in that maturity range was just over $4 billion.

Inflation and energy‑price concerns continue to weigh on the bond market. Since the end of July, the 10‑year yield has risen 60 basis points, while US crude oil prices have jumped about 20%. European bonds are also under pressure, with France’s 10‑year yield up 12 basis points to 4.876% and the UK’s 10‑year yield up 7 basis points to 5.447%.

The market is also watching for the Fed’s September meeting minutes, to be released at 2 p.m. Eastern Time, for clues after the first rate hike since 2023, and the New York Fed’s consumer expectations survey released at 11 a.m., which will provide inflation expectations for the next 1, 3 and 5 years.

items.title: 微軟、輝達CEO將親自站台 共推新款AI筆電 宣告「本地AI代理」時代來臨
items.title_en: Microsoft and Nvidia CEOs to Appear in Person to Launch New AI Laptop, Announcing the Era of "Local AI Agents"
paras: 分析師指出，微軟(MSFT-US)將於周三(7日)發表一款搭載輝達(NVDA-US)晶片的新筆記型電腦。此舉旨在將 Windows 打造為一個平台，讓 AI 代理(AI agents)能夠在無需存取雲端的情況下，處理編寫程式碼等任務。
微軟將在舊金山舉辦此次發表會，官方稱之為關於 Windows 作業系統及 Surface 硬體系列的更新發布。發表會上，預計由微軟執行長 Satya Nadella 與輝達執行長黃仁勳親自揭曉這款旗艦級筆電 Surface Laptop Ultra。
這款裝置搭載輝達與聯發科合作開發的 Arm 架構 RTX Spark 系統單晶片，並讓 AI 代理不必連線至雲端資料中心，即可直接在本地端執行撰寫程式碼或處理複雜商業專案等任務。
此策略有助於減輕微軟 Azure 資料中心的運算壓力，並在傳統由英特爾(INTC-US)與超微(AMD-US)主導的 Windows 個人電腦市場中，搶占邊緣運算先機，直接對標蘋果(AAPL-US)的 Mac 系列產品。
硬體配置方面，Surface Laptop Ultra 推出兩種版本，入門款搭載 18 核心 CPU 與 24GB 統一記憶體，高階款則配備 20 核心 CPU，記憶體最高可擴充至 128GB。螢幕採用 15 吋 mini-LED 觸控螢幕，輝達宣稱 RTX Spark 具備 1 Petaflop 的 FP4 AI 運算效能，且無論是否連接電源都能維持幾乎相同的效能輸出。
然而，價格成為該款筆電推廣的最大挑戰。受全球記憶體晶片短缺影響，高容量記憶體成本大幅攀升。市場預估 Surface Laptop Ultra 起售價將超過 2,000 美元，頂規 128GB 版本價格甚至可能高達 7,000 至 8,000 美元。
Moor Insights & Strategy 分析師 Anshel Sag表示，兩年前，軟體還沒準備好，但硬體準備好了。現在軟體準備好了，但硬體太貴，無法在本地運行，恐使本地端 AI 運算設備暫時成為僅有高預算買家才能負擔的奢華產品。
paras_en: Analysts note that Microsoft (MSFT-US) will unveil on Wednesday (the 7th) a new laptop powered by an Nvidia (NVDA-US) chip. The move aims to make Windows a platform where AI agents can perform tasks such as code writing without needing to access the cloud.

Microsoft will hold the launch in San Francisco, officially described as an update release for the Windows operating system and the Surface hardware lineup. The event is expected to feature Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella and Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang personally unveiling the flagship Surface Laptop Ultra.

The device is equipped with an Arm‑based RTX Spark system‑on‑chip co‑developed by Nvidia and MediaTek, allowing AI agents to run locally—writing code or handling complex business projects—without connecting to a cloud data center.

The strategy helps relieve computing pressure on Microsoft Azure data centers and aims to capture edge‑computing opportunities in the Windows PC market traditionally dominated by Intel (INTC-US) and AMD (AMD-US), directly challenging Apple’s (AAPL-US) Mac lineup.

In terms of hardware, the Surface Laptop Ultra will be offered in two configurations: a base model with an 18‑core CPU and 24 GB of unified memory, and a premium model with a 20‑core CPU and memory expandable up to 128 GB. It sports a 15‑inch mini‑LED touch display, and Nvidia claims the RTX Spark delivers 1 petaflop of FP4 AI performance, maintaining nearly identical output whether or not the laptop is plugged in.

However, price is the biggest hurdle for the laptop’s adoption. Global memory‑chip shortages have driven up the cost of high‑capacity RAM sharply. Market estimates put the starting price of the Surface Laptop Ultra above $2,000, with the top‑spec 128 GB version potentially costing $7,000 to $8,000.

Moor Insights & Strategy analyst Anshel Sag said that two years ago the software wasn’t ready but the hardware was; now the software is ready but the hardware is too expensive to run locally, risking that on‑premise AI compute devices will remain a luxury only affordable to high‑budget buyers.

items.title: 東航空姐下跪事件延燒 乘客是上市公司董事長？萬年青製藥回應
items.title_en: China Eastern Flight Attendant Kneeling Incident Escalates; Passenger Allegedly Chairman of Listed Company? Wan Nianqing Pharma Responds
paras: 東航(CEA-US) (00670-HK) 空姐下跪事件延燒，廣東萬年青製藥公司7日（周三）發布關於網路不實訊息侵害公司及相關人員名譽的聲明。
萬年青製藥公司表示，近日部分網路平台流傳「9月28日東航MU6741航班客艙衝突事件涉事旅客為廣東萬年青製藥股份有限公司董事長歐先濤先生」的內容，引發關注熱議。
萬年青製藥公司說，經公司核實，該內容與事實嚴重不符，歐先濤先生及公司其他員工從未乘坐該航班，上述訊息是惡意捏造，已侵害公司董事長個人名譽及公司商業信譽。
萬年青製藥公司稱，針對上述侵權行為，歐先濤先生已向公安機關報案，並獲受理，公司也同步就相關傳播內容展開證據留存與保全工作。公司將根據法律法規對造謠者及惡意傳播者追究全部法律責任。
上月29日一則「航班乘務員下跪」的帖子在社交平台流傳。
帖子稱，一架由合肥飛往大連的航班上，一名乘務員（空服員）推餐車時碰到旅客手肘並道歉，該旅客仍表示不滿，並提出「要嘛讓我踹一腳」等要求。
隨後乘務員哭泣、下跪，安全員介入，旅客還要求乘務長（座艙長）和涉事乘務員下班後陪同其前往醫院檢查。
據《極目新聞》報導，該網友張先生稱28日晚9時許，他乘坐從合肥到大連的航班，途中拍到上述一幕，「當時空姐跪了兩三次，挺久的，我沒有錄到全程影片」。
「餐車移動速度不快，那個被撞的男子沒出血，乘務長也拿來冰袋敷著，應該不嚴重。」張先生表示，後來該男子要求下機帶他去醫院檢查。
媒體報導後不久，張先生刪除上述影片，他說「電話被打爆了」。
東航對此表示，經核實，航班乘務員在推餐車提供飲料服務過程中，全程提示旅客注意，一名旅客處於睡眠狀態，不慎造成餐車與其手肘發生觸碰。
乘務員當即反覆致歉，查看旅客狀況。該旅客情緒激動，連續使用粗俗過激言語，並出現威脅腳踢乘務員、要求當事乘務員落地後陪同就醫等言行，該乘務員受到驚嚇。
為維護飛行安全和客艙秩序，乘務長、安全員迅速介入協同處置。航班落地後，醫護人員上機檢查旅客未有明顯外傷或腫脹、無須進一步處理，旅客拒絕地面人員陪同送醫，自行離開。
東航說，事件發生後，第一時間對當事乘務員展開心理疏導與關懷支持，該員工已恢復正常工作。在此，對關心支持民航一線員工的旅客、公眾表示感謝。
paras_en: China Eastern Airlines (CEA-US) (00670-HK) flight attendant kneeling incident continues to flare up, and Guangdong Wan Nianqing Pharmaceutical Company issued a statement on Wednesday the 7th regarding false online information that harmed the reputation of the company and related personnel.

Wan Nianqing Pharmaceutical said that recent posts on some online platforms claimed that the passenger involved in the September 28 cabin conflict on China Eastern MU6741 was Mr. Ou Xiantao, chairman of Guangdong Wan Nianqing Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd., sparking heated discussion.

The company stated that after verification, the claim is seriously inconsistent with facts; Mr. Ou and other employees never boarded that flight, the information is a malicious fabrication that has damaged the chairman’s personal reputation and the company’s commercial credibility.

Wan Nianqing said that regarding the infringement, Mr. Ou has reported the matter to public security authorities, which have accepted the case, and the company is simultaneously preserving evidence of the related content. The company will pursue full legal liability against the rumor‑mongers and malicious disseminators in accordance with laws and regulations.
A post about a "flight attendant kneeling" circulated on social media on the 29th of last month.

The post claimed that on a flight from Hefei to Dalian, a crew member (flight attendant) bumped a passenger’s elbow while pushing a trolley, apologized, but the passenger remained dissatisfied and demanded, among other things, "let me kick you".
Subsequently the crew member cried and knelt, a safety officer intervened, and the passenger also demanded that the purser and the involved crew member accompany him to a hospital after the flight.

According to Jimu News, the netizen Mr. Zhang said that around 9 p.m. on the 28th he was on the Hefei‑Dalian flight and captured the scene, noting "the flight attendant knelt two or three times, for quite a while; I didn’t record the whole video."

Mr. Zhang added, "The trolley wasn’t moving fast, the man who was hit didn’t bleed, the purser applied an ice pack, so it shouldn’t be serious." He later said the man requested to deplane and be taken to a hospital for examination.
Shortly after the media report, Mr. Zhang deleted the video, saying his phone was "bombarded with calls."

China Eastern said that after verification, during the beverage service the crew member repeatedly reminded passengers to be careful; a passenger who was asleep inadvertently caused the trolley to brush his elbow.

The crew member immediately apologized repeatedly and checked the passenger’s condition. The passenger became emotionally agitated, used vulgar and aggressive language, threatened to kick the crew member and demanded that the crew accompany him to a hospital after landing, which frightened the crew member.

To maintain flight safety and cabin order, the purser and safety officer promptly intervened and coordinated a response. After landing, medical staff inspected the passenger and found no obvious injuries or swelling, requiring no further treatment; the passenger refused ground staff accompaniment to a hospital and left on his own.

China Eastern said that after the incident, it promptly provided psychological counseling and support to the involved crew member, who has now returned to normal duties, and expressed gratitude to the passengers and public for their concern and support for frontline civil‑aviation staff.
